data.title: Finger-controlled robotic beetle sports artificial muscles and two-way feedback
data.description: Insects have long been a source of inspiration for robotics engineers. They are small, agile, and can squeeze into spaces where people can’t. Such robots are very useful for space exploration, inspecting industrial equipment, and even carrying out search-and-rescue operations. For certain purposes,…
